_comment: The starter team offered by the first-run wizard. Plain data: name, role (a slug from data/roles/roles.json), personality (a file in data/roles/personalities/), whether it is ticked by default, and a first message that proves the agent answers. The names, roles and personalities are only a starting point: change any of them later from the roster in the app. Nothing here is specific to any runtime; the wizard fills in the runtime and model the user chose.

agents.name: Jack
agents.summary: Team lead. Sets the goal, splits the work and keeps everyone on it.
agents.firstMessage: Hello Jack. In two sentences, what is your job on this team and what would you do first for me?

agents.name: McKay
agents.summary: Backend developer. Writes and tests code in the project folder you give it.
agents.firstMessage: Hello McKay. Look at the project folder and tell me, in three lines, what it is and how you would run it.

agents.name: Heimdall
agents.summary: Researcher. Reads and researches. Cannot edit files, so it is the safe one to try first.
agents.firstMessage: Hello Heimdall. In two sentences, what can you do for me here, and what can't you do?

agents.name: Samantha
agents.summary: Architect. Plans the work before it is built and settles design questions.
agents.firstMessage: Hello Samantha. In two sentences, how would you start planning a new project with me?

agents.name: Siler
agents.summary: Frontend developer. Builds and checks what people see and touch.
agents.firstMessage: Hello Siler. In two sentences, what do you check before you call a screen finished?
